remarks: Bright and spacious 1 bedroom, 1 full bath end unit in the heart of Stamford! Open concept layout living room and dining room with hardwood floors and a beautiful sunny balcony off of the living room. Large bedroom with large closet space. Freshly painted throughout, updated kitchen with newer appliances, and newer A/C units. Includes high speed washer/dryer in unit, in-ground pool, community meeting room, 1 reserved parking spot, and guest parking. Great location close to downtown Stamford restaurants, shops, theaters, train station, and I95.
